title: Past Unlimited & Current Fixed-Term Contracts in the UAE
description: Comparing unlimited and fixed-term contracts in the UAE? Understand the legal differences, your rights, and the impact of recent UAE Labour Law updates.

breadcrumb.name: Past Unlimited & Current Fixed-Term Contracts in the UAE

contentHtml:
Have you ever thought about how important the different sorts of employment contracts are when you’re trying to find your way in the UAE’s active and diversified job market? To get around this ever-changing job market, you need to know what unlimited and fixed-term agreements are.

We will explain hiring agreements and their basic categories so you can better understand the key factors that shape the UAE’s labor market. Let’s go into the details of a fixed-term and unlimited contract in the UAE, which are the main types of UAE Labor Contract options available. This will help you find the best solutions for both workers and businesses in the UAE who are exploring all possible employment arrangements.

Understanding the Fixed-Term and Unlimited Job Contracts in the UAE

It is extremely crucial for employers and workers to know about the several forms of contract of hire in the Emirates. The UAE labor law sets explicit rules for various forms of employment contracts, making sure that everyone follows the rules and is open about what they are doing.

Choosing an appropriate kind of contract at the start of any job is essential for reducing risks.  Do you know the various types of contracts that are out there and what makes them different from one another?

The Labor Law, which applies to all companies, says that employers may provide two main kinds of agreements: fixed-term and unlimited contracts in the UAE. There are significant variations between these sorts of contracts, such as how they handle statutory requirements and rights and what happens after the contract ends.

The Distinction between Fixed-Term and Unlimited Contracts in the UAE Job Market

The job market in the UAE is one of a kind, with a lot of different options. But employers and job seekers need to know how the law works. To understand employers’ and workers’ obligations, rights, and liabilities, let’s compare the most common limited contracts vs. unlimited contracts in the UAE.

Fixed-Term Work Agreement

These types of work agreements are suitable for jobs that are only required for a limited timeframe or a specific project. The employer and the staff member have already agreed on how long these contracts will last.

These contracts usually last for three years from the commencement of work, but this can be modified. Each party must agree to the renewal of the contract. This kind of contract is often used in fields where projects have set deadlines or need temporary workers.

Temporary Employment

Firms that perform project-based work or need people to fill specific roles for a certain amount of time prefer to use these contracts. Such agreements are good for employers who need short-term workers. 

Predetermined Timeframe:

This particular kind of contract predefined the date when the job will commence and end. The length of time may change based on the job and the type of project. But it can’t be more than four years in any case.

Information about the Salary: 

The agreement clearly states how much the worker will be paid, and that amount stays the same until the end of the agreement. But compensation may be modified if the employer and the worker consent to it.

Contract Extension:

This type of job agreement can be extended if both parties agree to do so. However, the employer can make a decision based on the employee’s performance, work arrangements, and further requirements.

End of the Contract:

If either party has a good reason, they can end the contract before it ends. But it also concisely states how long the notice period is and what will happen if neither the employer nor the worker doesn’t serve it.

Positive Aspects: 

Workers who prefer these contracts get benefits like paid time off, subsidies, health coverage, a bonus, and other perks.

Employer’s Opinion:

Employers adopt this type of contract because it lets them change their plans when a project change or seasonal changes happen. This kind of contract lets you hire people with specific skills for a set amount of time, so you don’t have to make long-term commitments. 

Staff Member’s Opinion:

Staff members looking for short-term jobs or project-based work often like these contracts. This kind of contract lets people who seek variation in their work life try out various tasks and roles without having to make long-term commitments.

Fixed-term agreements let the employer and the worker change things as needed by the evolving market trends. It also gives staff member short-term chances to work for the company, gain experience, and enhance their skills.

Unlimited Employment Agreement

What is an unlimited contract in the UAE? Unlimited agreements, also called open-ended contracts, have a predetermined beginning date but no fixed ending date. It makes things more stable and continuous for workers and employers. The conditions of the contract stay in effect until one of the parties decides to end the agreement.

These contracts are beneficial for long-term projects and permanent positions, so they are highly significant for workers who want to stay with a company for a long time. Most companies are getting rid of indefinite contracts because of changes to the Labor Law. All hiring agreements must now have a particular duration.

Long-Term Employment

An Unlimited Contract in the UAE is the best for companies that engage in long-term projects and continuous operations. This kind of contract makes things more stable for workers and employers, which helps build long-term relationships and encourages ongoing teamwork at work.

No Time Limit:

There is no predefined ending date for this kind of contract. The agreement declares that the conditions of service are until one of the staff members or the employer agrees to end it.

End of the Service: 

Before ending the unlimited agreement, the employer and the worker must inform each other and must provide a written notice. The agreement already declares how long the notice period is.

The Work Safety: 

This kind of contract makes workers feel safe in their jobs because it doesn’t have an end date. It also facilitates employees who want to work for a company for a long time and align with the organization’s goals and objectives.

Advantages: 

This type of contract with no limits offers various benefits, such as paid leave, overtime pay, and end-of-service benefits.

For the Employer:

An employer’s commitment to establishing and keeping a stable workforce is apparent by unlimited contracts. This promise makes employees feel safe and encourages them to stay loyal. Companies that want to develop long-lasting relationships with their employees and are always working like this often prefer these kinds of agreements.

For the Employee:

Unlimited contracts in the UAE are appealing to workers who want stability, secure employment, and an ongoing commitment from their employers. These open-ended job offers give workers a sense of safety and pride in the company. It makes them especially appealing to people who want stable and long-lasting careers.

Unlimited Term Agreements give companies and employees a strong reason to be dedicated and loyal to each other. It makes it easier for them to work in collaboration for a long time.

Recent Impact of New Regulatory Changes on the Job Market: Fixed-term and Unlimited Contract

Work contracts have undergone significant change as a result of recent updates to the UAE Labor Law. It is primarily phasing out unlimited job contracts and promoting the use of renewable fixed-term job contracts that normally end after three years. The goal of this change is to give employers and workers more clarity and order. 

Fixed-term agreements can be broadened even though they add a specified end date. If an employee stays on the job after the contract expires, the contract will automatically be renewed under identical circumstances. To improve worker protection against arbitrary termination, the new law also places a strong emphasis on explicit dismissal guidelines and notice periods for both contract types.

To promote a more open and fair labor market, employers are now required to make sure that all contracts adhere to these updated regulations.

Final Words

When looking at the clauses, length, end-of-service gratuity, and other benefits, it was easy to see that these two types of employment contracts were quite distinct. The UAE Labor Law has an extensive set of rules and guidelines about employer and worker relations in the workplace. This article only talks about the variations between a fixed-term agreement and an unlimited contract. It gives our readers a general idea of what these contracts symbolize and imply.For more related insights, you can also explore other helpful resources on Emiratisation Gate.

FAQs

What is the expected timespan of a fixed-term contract in the UAE?

A fixed-term contract’s expected timeframe is normally three years, though both parties may agree to extend it.

What conditions apply if an employer dismisses a job contract early?

According to UAE labor law, notice periods or salary must be provided in cases of early dismissal.

What are the Gratuity calculation methods for fixed-term and unlimited job contracts?

According to UAE labor law, gratuity is based on how long the employee has worked and the provisions of their contract.

Is an unlimited contract still valid in the UAE?

Not now; according to the current rules, employers must predefine the ending date of the contract in the UAE.
